nodes.name: VirtualMachines
nodes.summary: MyOpenLab Virtual Machines directory containing microcontroller compiler toolchains for Arduino (AVR), ATmega168/328, and PIC 16F877 — translates visual logic diagrams into C source code for embedded targets.

nodes.name: ArduinoCompiler
nodes.summary: Arduino C code compiler — translates MyOpenLab visual programs to Arduino-compatible C source. Contains a lexer, parser, stack interpreter, and code generator targeting the Arduino platform.

nodes.name: ATmega168_328Compiler
nodes.summary: ATmega168/328 C compiler — translates MyOpenLab visual programs to C code for ATmega168 and ATmega328 microcontrollers. Shares architecture with ArduinoCompiler but targets bare-metal AVR without the Arduino framework.

nodes.name: PIC_16F877_Compiler
nodes.summary: PIC 16F877 C compiler — translates MyOpenLab visual programs to C code for the Microchip PIC 16F877 microcontroller. Includes both Java compiler sources and a native C compiler helper.

nodes.name: ArduinoCompiler.java
nodes.summary: Main entry point for the Arduino compiler — orchestrates lexing, parsing, stack interpretation, and C code generation for Arduino targets.

nodes.name: ArduinoCompiler
nodes.summary: Main compiler class — coordinates the compilation pipeline: load visual program, tokenize, parse into nodes, run stack interpreter, emit Arduino C code.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Entry point — loads the visual program definition, initializes the compiler pipeline, and triggers C code emission.

nodes.name: compile
nodes.summary: Compilation orchestrator — invokes the tokenizer, parser (Node tree), stack interpreter, and C code emitter in sequence.

nodes.name: C_Code.java
nodes.summary: C code generation utilities — builds Arduino C source strings from the interpreted program state, including setup() and loop() structure.

nodes.name: C_Code
nodes.summary: C code emitter — generates Arduino-compatible C source, managing pin initialization, the setup/loop structure, and variable declarations.

nodes.name: generateSetup
nodes.summary: Generates the Arduino setup() function body — pin mode configuration, serial init, and variable initialization.

nodes.name: generateLoop
nodes.summary: Generates the Arduino loop() function body — the main program cycle translated from the visual logic.

nodes.name: Compiler.java
nodes.summary: Core compiler backend — contains the parsing and code generation logic specific to the Arduino target platform.

nodes.name: Compiler
nodes.summary: Compiler backend — parses the token stream into an executable program structure, resolves element references, and drives C code emission.

nodes.name: parseProgram
nodes.summary: Parses the tokenized visual program into an internal representation (Node tree) for further processing.

nodes.name: generateCode
nodes.summary: Generates Arduino C code from the parsed program structure using the C_Code utility class.

nodes.name: Element.java
nodes.summary: Visual program element model — represents a single block or node in the MyOpenLab visual program for the Arduino compiler.

nodes.name: Element
nodes.summary: Model class for a visual program element — stores element type, inputs, outputs, and properties for the Arduino compiler.

nodes.name: GlobalVars.java
nodes.summary: Global variable management — defines the symbol table for global variables used across the compiled Arduino program.

nodes.name: GlobalVars
nodes.summary: Global variable symbol table — manages declaration, type resolution, and scoping of global variables across the compiled program.

nodes.name: MyStreamTokenizer.java
nodes.summary: Custom stream tokenizer — tokenizes MyOpenLab visual program serialized format into tokens for the Arduino compiler.

nodes.name: MyStreamTokenizer
nodes.summary: Custom lexer — reads the serialized visual program format and produces a token stream for the parser.

nodes.name: nextToken
nodes.summary: Retrieves the next token from the input stream, classifying it as identifier, number, symbol, or string literal.

nodes.name: Node.java
nodes.summary: Abstract syntax tree node — represents a parsed program element in the Arduino compiler's internal tree representation.

nodes.name: Node
nodes.summary: AST node — forms the tree representation of the program; each node corresponds to a visual element or connector.

nodes.name: StackInterpreter.java
nodes.summary: Stack-based interpreter — executes the visual program logic on a virtual stack machine to determine C code output for Arduino.

nodes.name: StackInterpreter
nodes.summary: Stack-based VM interpreter — walks the Node tree and executes operations via a push/pop stack machine, producing the linearized program flow for C code generation.

nodes.name: interpret
nodes.summary: Main interpretation loop — pushes/pops operations on the stack according to the program's node topology.

nodes.name: evaluateNode
nodes.summary: Evaluates a single Node — resolves its operation type, pops operands from the stack, computes results, and pushes them back.

nodes.name: Var.java
nodes.summary: Variable representation — models a typed variable used in the Arduino compiler's internal state during code generation.

nodes.name: Var
nodes.summary: Variable descriptor — holds name, type, value, and scope information for variables within the compiled Arduino program.

edges.description: Both compilers target AVR-based microcontrollers (Arduino uses ATmega chips) — share compiler architecture patterns including tokenizer, parser, stack interpreter, and C code generation.
Both are bare-metal microcontroller compilers for non-Arduino targets — share the same compiler pipeline architecture with target-specific C code emission.
Analogous tokenizer classes across Arduino and ATmega compilers — implement the same lexer pattern with target-specific token handling.
Analogous stack interpreter classes across Arduino and ATmega compilers — implement the same virtual stack machine pattern.
Analogous stack interpreter classes across Arduino and PIC compilers — implement the same virtual stack machine pattern for different MCU targets.
Native C helper file that provides low-level AVR routines or acts as a reference compiler implementation for the ATmega target.
Native C helper file that provides PIC-specific routines or acts as a reference compiler implementation for the PIC 16F877 target.
